structure: plain form/noun + にもかかわらず

meaning.fr: despite, in spite of

examples.jp: 大雨にもかかわらず、試合は行われた。
examples.en: Despite the heavy rain, the match was held.
examples.fr: Despite the heavy rain, the match was held.

examples.jp: 何度も注意したにもかかわらず、彼は同じ失敗をした。
examples.en: In spite of being warned many times, he made the same mistake.
examples.fr: In spite of being warned many times, he made the same mistake.

structure: verb ない-stem + ざるを得ない

meaning.fr: have no choice but to

examples.jp: 台風のため、旅行を中止せざるを得なかった。
examples.en: Because of the typhoon, we had no choice but to cancel the trip.
examples.fr: Because of the typhoon, we had no choice but to cancel the trip.

examples.jp: この数字を見れば、失敗を認めざるを得ない。
examples.en: Looking at these figures, one cannot but admit the failure.
examples.fr: Looking at these figures, one cannot but admit the failure.

meaning.fr: while doing, despite doing (contrast)

examples.jp: 体に悪いと知りつつも、たばこをやめられない。
examples.en: Even while knowing it is bad for my health, I cannot quit smoking.
examples.fr: Even while knowing it is bad for my health, I cannot quit smoking.

examples.jp: 悪いと思いつつも、まだあやまっていない。
examples.en: Although I feel bad about it, I still have not apologised.
examples.fr: Although I feel bad about it, I still have not apologised.

structure: verb た-form/noun + の + あげくに

meaning.en: after all that (leading to a bad outcome)
meaning.fr: after all that (leading to a bad outcome)

examples.jp: 長い間迷ったあげくに、彼は会社を辞めた。
examples.en: After hesitating for a long time, he ended up quitting the company.
examples.fr: After hesitating for a long time, he ended up quitting the company.

examples.jp: 何時間も話し合ったあげくに、答えは出なかった。
examples.en: After discussing for hours, in the end no answer emerged.
examples.fr: After discussing for hours, in the end no answer emerged.

structure: noun/verb dictionary form + に伴って

meaning.fr: as, along with (a change)

examples.jp: 人口の増加に伴って、住宅の問題も大きくなった。
examples.en: Along with the increase in population, the housing problem also grew.
examples.fr: Along with the increase in population, the housing problem also grew.

examples.jp: 気温が上がるに伴って、雪が解け始めた。
examples.en: As the temperature rose, the snow began to melt.
examples.fr: As the temperature rose, the snow began to melt.

meaning.fr: based on

examples.jp: この映画は実際の事件に基づいて作られた。
examples.en: This film was made based on a real incident.
examples.fr: This film was made based on a real incident.

examples.jp: 調査に基づいて、計画を立て直した。
examples.en: We rebuilt the plan based on the survey.
examples.fr: We rebuilt the plan based on the survey.

structure: plain form + からといって

meaning.fr: just because ... (doesn't mean)

examples.jp: 値段が高いからといって、品質がいいとは限らない。
examples.en: Just because the price is high does not mean the quality is good.
examples.fr: Just because the price is high does not mean the quality is good.

examples.jp: 若いからといって、むりをしてはいけない。
examples.en: Just because you are young does not mean you should overdo it.
examples.fr: Just because you are young does not mean you should overdo it.

meaning.fr: far from, let alone

examples.jp: 彼は漢字どころか、ひらがなも読めない。
examples.en: Far from kanji, he cannot even read hiragana.
examples.fr: Far from kanji, he cannot even read hiragana.

examples.jp: 雨は止むどころか、ますます強くなった。
examples.en: Far from stopping, the rain grew even stronger.
examples.fr: Far from stopping, the rain grew even stronger.

meaning.fr: is nothing more than, merely

examples.jp: 私が知っているのは、ほんの一部にすぎない。
examples.en: What I know is nothing more than a small part.
examples.fr: What I know is nothing more than a small part.

examples.jp: それはただの言いのがれにすぎない。
examples.en: That is merely an evasion.
examples.fr: That is merely an evasion.

meaning.fr: regardless of

examples.jp: この仕事は経験を問わず、だれでも申し込める。
examples.en: Regardless of experience, anyone can apply for this job.
examples.fr: Regardless of experience, anyone can apply for this job.

examples.jp: 昼夜を問わず、工場は動いている。
examples.en: The factory runs regardless of day or night.
examples.fr: The factory runs regardless of day or night.

meaning.en: not to mention, needless to say
meaning.fr: not to mention, needless to say

examples.jp: 彼は英語はもとより、中国語も話せる。
examples.en: He can speak Chinese, not to mention English.
examples.fr: He can speak Chinese, not to mention English.

examples.jp: この店は味はもとより、値段も安い。
examples.en: This restaurant is cheap, not to mention the taste.
examples.fr: This restaurant is cheap, not to mention the taste.

meaning.en: used to (reminiscing); also: it's only natural that
meaning.fr: used to (reminiscing); also: it's only natural that

examples.jp: 子どものころ、よくこの川で泳いだものだ。
examples.en: When I was a child, I used to swim in this river a lot.
examples.fr: When I was a child, I used to swim in this river a lot.

examples.jp: 学生時代はよく先生に注意されたものだ。
examples.en: In my student days I used to get warned by teachers a lot.
examples.fr: In my student days I used to get warned by teachers a lot.

structure: verb て-form + からでないと

meaning.fr: not until after, unless ... first

examples.jp: よく調べてからでないと、返事はできません。
examples.en: I cannot answer unless I look into it properly first.
examples.fr: I cannot answer unless I look into it properly first.

examples.jp: 係の人に聞いてからでないと、中には入れません。
examples.en: You cannot go inside until after you ask the attendant.
examples.fr: You cannot go inside until after you ask the attendant.

meaning.fr: hard to do, difficult to

examples.jp: 彼が犯人だとは信じがたい。
examples.en: It is hard to believe that he is the culprit.
examples.fr: It is hard to believe that he is the culprit.

examples.jp: あの日のことは忘れがたい思い出だ。
examples.en: What happened that day is a memory hard to forget.
examples.fr: What happened that day is a memory hard to forget.

meaning.fr: might result in (something undesirable)

examples.jp: そんな運転をしていては、大けがをしかねない。
examples.en: Driving like that could well cause a serious injury.
examples.fr: Driving like that could well cause a serious injury.

examples.jp: この問題を放っておくと、大きな損害になりかねない。
examples.en: If we leave this problem alone, it might result in serious damage.
examples.fr: If we leave this problem alone, it might result in serious damage.

meaning.fr: only, ever since (and nothing since)

examples.jp: 彼とは去年会ったきり、一度も会っていない。
examples.en: I met him last year and have not seen him once since.
examples.fr: I met him last year and have not seen him once since.

examples.jp: 父は朝出かけたきり、まだ帰らない。
examples.en: My father went out in the morning and still has not come back.
examples.fr: My father went out in the morning and still has not come back.

meaning.fr: excluding, without

examples.jp: 朝食ぬきで学校へ行くのは体に悪い。
examples.en: Going to school without breakfast is bad for your health.
examples.fr: Going to school without breakfast is bad for your health.

examples.jp: 今日はかたい話ぬきで楽しみましょう。
examples.en: Let us enjoy ourselves today without the formal talk.
examples.fr: Let us enjoy ourselves today without the formal talk.

meaning.fr: now that, since (implies obligation)

examples.jp: 引き受けたからには、最後までやり通します。
examples.en: Now that I have taken it on, I will see it through to the end.
examples.fr: Now that I have taken it on, I will see it through to the end.

examples.jp: 約束したからには、守らなければならない。
examples.en: Since you have made a promise, you must keep it.
examples.fr: Since you have made a promise, you must keep it.

structure: verb ない-stem + ずにはいられない

meaning.fr: can't help but do

examples.jp: あの映画を見ると、なかずにはいられない。
examples.en: When I watch that film, I cannot help but cry.
examples.fr: When I watch that film, I cannot help but cry.

examples.jp: 彼の話を聞いて、笑わずにはいられなかった。
examples.en: Hearing his story, I could not help laughing.
examples.fr: Hearing his story, I could not help laughing.

structure: plain form / noun + ばかりか

meaning.fr: not only that, but also

examples.jp: 彼は日本語ばかりか、中国語も話せる。
examples.en: He can speak not only Japanese but Chinese as well.
examples.fr: He can speak not only Japanese but Chinese as well.

examples.jp: この部屋はせまいばかりか、暗くて寒い。
examples.en: This room is not only cramped but dark and cold.
examples.fr: This room is not only cramped but dark and cold.

meaning.en: simply because — and it went badly
meaning.fr: simply because — and it went badly

examples.jp: 一言余計なことを言ったばかりに、彼を怒らせてしまった。
examples.en: Simply because I said one unnecessary word, I made him angry.
examples.fr: Simply because I said one unnecessary word, I made him angry.

examples.jp: 道を間違えたばかりに、電車に乗り遅れた。
examples.en: Just because I took the wrong road, I missed the train.
examples.fr: Just because I took the wrong road, I missed the train.

structure: plain form / noun + のみならず

meaning.fr: not only but also (formal)

examples.jp: この薬は大人のみならず、子どもにも効く。
examples.en: This medicine works not only on adults but on children too.
examples.fr: This medicine works not only on adults but on children too.

examples.jp: 彼は研究のみならず、教育にも力を入れている。
examples.en: He puts effort not only into research but into education as well.
examples.fr: He puts effort not only into research but into education as well.

meaning.fr: in response to, varying with

examples.jp: 料金は年齢に応じて変わります。
examples.en: The fee changes according to age.
examples.fr: The fee changes according to age.

examples.jp: 客の希望に応じて、料理を作ります。
examples.en: We prepare dishes in response to the customer wishes.
examples.fr: We prepare dishes in response to the customer wishes.

structure: noun / plain form + にかかわらず

meaning.fr: regardless of, irrespective of

examples.jp: 天候にかかわらず、大会は開かれる。
examples.en: Regardless of the weather, the tournament will be held.
examples.fr: Regardless of the weather, the tournament will be held.

examples.jp: 経験のあるなしにかかわらず、申し込めます。
examples.en: You may apply irrespective of whether you have experience.
examples.fr: You may apply irrespective of whether you have experience.

meaning.en: not limited to, and not only
meaning.fr: not limited to, and not only

examples.jp: この問題は日本に限らず、世界中で起きている。
examples.en: This problem occurs not only in Japan but all over the world.
examples.fr: This problem occurs not only in Japan but all over the world.

examples.jp: 土曜日に限らず、いつでも開いています。
examples.en: It is open any time, not just on Saturdays.
examples.fr: It is open any time, not just on Saturdays.

meaning.en: when it comes to — where someone excels
meaning.fr: when it comes to — where someone excels

examples.jp: 走ることにかけては、彼にかなう者はいない。
examples.en: When it comes to running, no one can beat him.
examples.fr: When it comes to running, no one can beat him.

examples.jp: 料理の早さにかけては自信があります。
examples.en: When it comes to speed of cooking, I am confident.
examples.fr: When it comes to speed of cooking, I am confident.

meaning.en: in addition to, on top of
meaning.fr: in addition to, on top of

examples.jp: 強い風に加えて、雨まで降り出した。
examples.en: In addition to the strong wind, it even started to rain.
examples.fr: In addition to the strong wind, it even started to rain.

examples.jp: 彼は実力に加えて、運にも助けられた。
examples.en: In addition to his ability, he was helped by luck as well.
examples.fr: In addition to his ability, he was helped by luck as well.

structure: noun / verb dictionary form + に先立って

meaning.fr: prior to, ahead of

examples.jp: 開会に先立って、館長があいさつをした。
examples.en: Prior to the opening, the director gave a greeting.
examples.fr: Prior to the opening, the director gave a greeting.

examples.jp: 旅行に先立って、必要な物を買いそろえた。
examples.en: Ahead of the trip, I bought all the necessary things.
examples.fr: Ahead of the trip, I bought all the necessary things.

meaning.fr: contrary to, against

examples.jp: 予想に反して、試験はやさしかった。
examples.en: Contrary to expectations, the exam was easy.
examples.fr: Contrary to expectations, the exam was easy.

examples.jp: 親の願いに反して、彼は音楽の道を選んだ。
examples.en: Contrary to his parents wishes, he chose the path of music.
examples.fr: Contrary to his parents wishes, he chose the path of music.

meaning.fr: is nothing other than

examples.jp: 彼が勝ったのは、努力のたまものにほかならない。
examples.en: His victory is nothing other than the fruit of his effort.
examples.fr: His victory is nothing other than the fruit of his effort.

examples.jp: この失敗は準備不足にほかならない。
examples.en: This failure is nothing other than a lack of preparation.
examples.fr: This failure is nothing other than a lack of preparation.

meaning.fr: surrounding, over (a contested matter)

examples.jp: 土地の使い方をめぐって、住民の意見が分かれた。
examples.en: Opinions among residents were divided over how to use the land.
examples.fr: Opinions among residents were divided over how to use the land.

examples.jp: その発言をめぐって、大きな議論が起きた。
examples.en: A big argument arose surrounding that remark.
examples.fr: A big argument arose surrounding that remark.

meaning.en: through, by way of; also: throughout
meaning.fr: through, by way of; also: throughout

examples.jp: 友人を通じて、その会社を知りました。
examples.en: I learned about that company through a friend.
examples.fr: I learned about that company through a friend.

examples.jp: この地方は一年を通じて雨が多い。
examples.en: This region has a lot of rain throughout the year.
examples.fr: This region has a lot of rain throughout the year.

meaning.en: starting with, and others of its kind
meaning.fr: starting with, and others of its kind

examples.jp: 校長先生をはじめ、多くの先生が集まった。
examples.en: Starting with the principal, many teachers gathered.
examples.fr: Starting with the principal, many teachers gathered.

examples.jp: 東京をはじめ、大きな町では部屋代が高い。
examples.en: In big cities, starting with Tokyo, room costs are high.
examples.fr: In big cities, starting with Tokyo, room costs are high.

meaning.en: on the basis of, working from
meaning.fr: on the basis of, working from

examples.jp: この物語は古い伝説をもとに書かれた。
examples.en: This story was written on the basis of an old legend.
examples.fr: This story was written on the basis of an old legend.

examples.jp: 調べた資料をもとに、発表の準備をした。
examples.en: I prepared my presentation working from the material I had researched.
examples.fr: I prepared my presentation working from the material I had researched.

structure: verb stem + 得る・得ない

meaning.fr: can possibly / cannot possibly (formal)

examples.jp: そんなことは十分あり得る話だ。
examples.en: That is something that could quite possibly happen.
examples.fr: That is something that could quite possibly happen.

examples.jp: 彼がうそをつくとは考え得ない。
examples.en: It is unthinkable that he would tell a lie.
examples.fr: It is unthinkable that he would tell a lie.

meaning.en: cannot bring oneself to, is unable to
meaning.fr: cannot bring oneself to, is unable to

examples.jp: その件については、お答えしかねます。
examples.en: I am unable to answer regarding that matter.
examples.fr: I am unable to answer regarding that matter.

examples.jp: その品は今、お売りしかねます。
examples.en: We are unable to sell that item at present.
examples.fr: We are unable to sell that item at present.

structure: verb dictionary form + ことなく

meaning.fr: without ever doing (formal)

examples.jp: 彼は一度も休むことなく働き続けた。
examples.en: He kept working without ever taking a single break.
examples.fr: He kept working without ever taking a single break.

examples.jp: 機械は昼も夜も止まることなく動いている。
examples.en: The machine runs day and night without stopping.
examples.fr: The machine runs day and night without stopping.

structure: verb ない-form + ことには

meaning.fr: unless you first, without doing

examples.jp: 実際に見ないことには、何とも言えない。
examples.en: Unless I actually see it, I cannot say anything.
examples.fr: Unless I actually see it, I cannot say anything.

examples.jp: 練習しないことには、上手にならない。
examples.en: Without practising, you will not get better.
examples.fr: Without practising, you will not get better.

structure: plain form + ということだ

meaning.en: it amounts to; also: I hear that
meaning.fr: it amounts to; also: I hear that

examples.jp: 彼は来月国へ帰るということだ。
examples.en: I hear that he is going back to his country next month.
examples.fr: I hear that he is going back to his country next month.

examples.jp: 返事がないということは、断られたということだ。
examples.en: No reply means that we have been refused.
examples.fr: No reply means that we have been refused.

structure: plain form / noun + というより

meaning.fr: rather than saying, more ... than

examples.jp: あの人はこわいというより、冷たい。
examples.en: That person is cold rather than frightening.
examples.fr: That person is cold rather than frightening.

examples.jp: これは食事というより、おやつだ。
examples.en: This is a snack rather than a meal.
examples.fr: This is a snack rather than a meal.

structure: verb dictionary form + わけにはいかない

meaning.en: cannot very well, is not an option
meaning.fr: cannot very well, is not an option

examples.jp: 大切な会議だから、休むわけにはいかない。
examples.en: It is an important meeting, so I cannot very well take the day off.
examples.fr: It is an important meeting, so I cannot very well take the day off.

examples.jp: 車で来たので、お酒を飲むわけにはいかない。
examples.en: I came by car, so drinking is not an option.
examples.fr: I came by car, so drinking is not an option.

structure: noun / verb dictionary form + に際して

meaning.fr: at the moment of undertaking

examples.jp: 出発に際して、荷物をよく確認してください。
examples.en: Please check your luggage carefully before departure.
examples.fr: Please check your luggage carefully before departure.

examples.jp: 開会に際して、一言ごあいさつ申し上げます。
examples.en: On the occasion of the opening, allow me to say a few words.
examples.fr: On the occasion of the opening, allow me to say a few words.

structure: noun / verb dictionary form + にあたって

meaning.en: on the occasion of something significant
meaning.fr: on the occasion of something significant

examples.jp: 試験を受けるにあたって、計画を立てた。
examples.en: With the exam coming up, I made a plan.
examples.fr: With the exam coming up, I made a plan.

examples.jp: 出発にあたって、家族に手紙を書いた。
examples.en: On the occasion of my departure, I wrote to my family.
examples.fr: On the occasion of my departure, I wrote to my family.

meaning.en: by means of; also: as of a stated date
meaning.fr: by means of; also: as of a stated date

examples.jp: 本日をもって、この店は閉店いたします。
examples.en: As of today, this shop closes for good.
examples.fr: As of today, this shop closes for good.

examples.jp: 彼は実力をもって、周囲を認めさせた。
examples.en: He made those around him acknowledge him by sheer ability.
examples.fr: He made those around him acknowledge him by sheer ability.

meaning.en: under the guidance or conditions of
meaning.fr: under the guidance or conditions of

examples.jp: 先生のもとで、三年間研究を続けた。
examples.en: I continued my research for three years under my professor.
examples.fr: I continued my research for three years under my professor.

examples.jp: 新しい社長のもとで、会社は大きく変わった。
examples.en: Under the new president, the company changed greatly.
examples.fr: Under the new president, the company changed greatly.

meaning.en: keeping to a line or a policy
meaning.fr: keeping to a line or a policy

examples.jp: 川に沿って、細い道が続いている。
examples.en: A narrow path runs along the river.
examples.fr: A narrow path runs along the river.

examples.jp: 計画に沿って、作業を進めています。
examples.en: We are proceeding with the work in line with the plan.
examples.fr: We are proceeding with the work in line with the plan.

meaning.en: with that as the thing that set it off
meaning.fr: with that as the thing that set it off

examples.jp: 入院をきっかけに、たばこをやめた。
examples.en: Being hospitalised was what made me give up smoking.
examples.fr: Being hospitalised was what made me give up smoking.

examples.jp: 留学をきっかけに、彼の考え方が変わった。
examples.en: Studying abroad was the thing that changed his outlook.
examples.fr: Studying abroad was the thing that changed his outlook.

meaning.en: taking that as the turning point
meaning.fr: taking that as the turning point

examples.jp: 入学を契機に、生活が大きく変わった。
examples.en: Starting school was the turning point at which life changed greatly.
examples.fr: Starting school was the turning point at which life changed greatly.

examples.jp: 病気を契機に、生活を見直した。
examples.en: Illness was the trigger for rethinking how I live.
examples.fr: Illness was the trigger for rethinking how I live.

meaning.en: while the opposite is also true
meaning.fr: while the opposite is also true

examples.jp: この方法は速い反面、費用が高い。
examples.en: This method is fast, but on the other hand it is expensive.
examples.fr: This method is fast, but on the other hand it is expensive.

examples.jp: 都会は便利な反面、物の値段が高い。
examples.en: Cities are convenient, while prices are high.
examples.fr: Cities are convenient, while prices are high.

meaning.en: the trend only continues in one direction
meaning.fr: the trend only continues in one direction

examples.jp: この町の人口は減る一方だ。
examples.en: The population of this town only keeps falling.
examples.fr: The population of this town only keeps falling.

examples.jp: 物の値段は上がる一方です。
examples.en: Prices just keep on rising.
examples.fr: Prices just keep on rising.

structure: verb dictionary form + ばかりだ

meaning.en: gets steadily more so, and only that
meaning.fr: gets steadily more so, and only that

examples.jp: けがの具合は悪くなるばかりだ。
examples.en: The injury is only getting worse.
examples.fr: The injury is only getting worse.

examples.jp: 待っていても、不安は増すばかりだった。
examples.en: Waiting only made the anxiety grow.
examples.fr: Waiting only made the anxiety grow.

meaning.en: surely not; also: I have no intention of
meaning.fr: surely not; also: I have no intention of

examples.jp: 二度と同じ失敗はするまいと決めた。
examples.en: I resolved never to make the same mistake again.
examples.fr: I resolved never to make the same mistake again.

examples.jp: この雨では、彼は来るまい。
examples.en: In this rain, he surely will not come.
examples.fr: In this rain, he surely will not come.

structure: verb dictionary form + ことはない

meaning.en: there is no call for it
meaning.fr: there is no call for it

examples.jp: そんなに心配することはない。
examples.en: There is no need to worry so much.
examples.fr: There is no need to worry so much.

examples.jp: 一度の失敗で、あきらめることはない。
examples.en: There's no call to give up over one failure.
examples.fr: There's no call to give up over one failure.

meaning.en: there is something distinctly ... about it
meaning.fr: there is something distinctly ... about it

examples.jp: 彼の話には、人を引きつけるものがある。
examples.en: There is something about the way he talks that draws people in.
examples.fr: There is something about the way he talks that draws people in.

examples.jp: その言葉には、心を動かすものがある。
examples.en: There is something in those words that moves the heart.
examples.fr: There is something in those words that moves the heart.

structure: verb potential form + ものなら

meaning.en: if such a thing were possible at all
meaning.fr: if such a thing were possible at all

examples.jp: 行けるものなら、今すぐ国へ帰りたい。
examples.en: If I could, I would go home to my country this instant.
examples.fr: If I could, I would go home to my country this instant.

examples.jp: やり直せるものなら、やり直したい。
examples.en: If it were possible to start over, I would.
examples.fr: If it were possible to start over, I would.

meaning.en: a flat refusal to accept it
meaning.fr: a flat refusal to accept it

examples.jp: あんな店に、二度と行くものか。
examples.en: As if I would ever go to that shop again!
examples.fr: As if I would ever go to that shop again!

examples.jp: 彼の言うことなど、信じるものか。
examples.en: As if I would believe anything he says!
examples.fr: As if I would believe anything he says!

structure: plain form / noun + だけあって

meaning.en: and it shows, as one would expect
meaning.fr: and it shows, as one would expect

examples.jp: 長年練習しただけあって、とても上手だ。
examples.en: Having practised for years, he is very good, as one would expect.
examples.fr: Having practised for years, he is very good, as one would expect.

examples.jp: 有名な店だけあって、味は確かだ。
examples.en: It's a famous restaurant, and sure enough the food is good.
examples.fr: It's a famous restaurant, and sure enough the food is good.

meaning.en: and all the more so because of it
meaning.fr: and all the more so because of it

examples.jp: 期待が大きかっただけに、失望も大きい。
examples.en: The hopes were high, and the disappointment is all the greater for it.
examples.fr: The hopes were high, and the disappointment is all the greater for it.

examples.jp: 初めての土地だけに、不安も感じた。
examples.en: It being unfamiliar country, I felt all the more uneasy.
examples.fr: It being unfamiliar country, I felt all the more uneasy.

meaning.en: and upon doing so, this followed
meaning.fr: and upon doing so, this followed

examples.jp: 先生に相談したところ、すぐに解決した。
examples.en: When I consulted my teacher, it was resolved at once.
examples.fr: When I consulted my teacher, it was resolved at once.

examples.jp: 店に問い合わせたところ、まだ在庫があった。
examples.en: When I enquired at the shop, they still had stock.
examples.fr: When I enquired at the shop, they still had stock.

meaning.en: even doing so would change nothing
meaning.fr: even doing so would change nothing

examples.jp: 今から急いだところで、間に合わない。
examples.en: Even if we hurried now, we would not make it.
examples.fr: Even if we hurried now, we would not make it.

examples.jp: 今さら言ったところで、何も変わらない。
examples.en: Saying it now would change nothing.
examples.fr: Saying it now would change nothing.

structure: verb て-form + はならない

meaning.fr: a formal prohibition

examples.jp: この場所に車を止めてはならない。
examples.en: Vehicles must not be parked in this place.
examples.fr: Vehicles must not be parked in this place.

examples.jp: 約束を軽く考えてはならない。
examples.en: A promise must not be taken lightly.
examples.fr: A promise must not be taken lightly.

meaning.en: just as though it were so
meaning.fr: just as though it were so

examples.jp: 彼はすべてを知っているかのように話す。
examples.en: He talks as though he knows everything.
examples.fr: He talks as though he knows everything.

examples.jp: その部屋は時が止まったかのようだった。
examples.en: The room was as if time had stopped in it.
examples.fr: The room was as if time had stopped in it.

structure: noun / verb た-form + も + 同然

meaning.en: as good as, in all but name
meaning.fr: as good as, in all but name

examples.jp: この家は新品同然だ。
examples.en: This house is as good as new.
examples.fr: This house is as good as new.

examples.jp: 彼は家族も同然の親しい友人だ。
examples.en: He is a close friend, practically family.
examples.fr: He is a close friend, practically family.

meaning.en: there can be no doubt of it
meaning.fr: there can be no doubt of it

examples.jp: この字を見れば、彼が書いたに相違ない。
examples.en: Looking at this hand, there can be no doubt he wrote it.
examples.fr: Looking at this hand, there can be no doubt he wrote it.

examples.jp: あの様子から見て、うまくいったに相違ない。
examples.en: From the look of things, it must surely have gone well.
examples.fr: From the look of things, it must surely have gone well.

structure: plain form + に決まっている

meaning.en: it is bound to turn out that way
meaning.fr: it is bound to turn out that way

examples.jp: あんな安い品物は、質が悪いに決まっている。
examples.en: Goods that cheap are bound to be poor quality.
examples.fr: Goods that cheap are bound to be poor quality.

examples.jp: 今から出ても、遅れるに決まっている。
examples.en: Even leaving now, we're bound to be late.
examples.fr: Even leaving now, we're bound to be late.

meaning.en: if that is how it is going, then
meaning.fr: if that is how it is going, then

examples.jp: こんな成績を取るようでは、合格できない。
examples.en: If you're going to get marks like these, you won't pass.
examples.fr: If you're going to get marks like these, you won't pass.

examples.jp: すぐにあきらめるようでは、上達しない。
examples.en: If you give up that quickly, you will not improve.
examples.fr: If you give up that quickly, you will not improve.

structure: verb dictionary form + くらいなら

meaning.en: sooner than put up with that
meaning.fr: sooner than put up with that

examples.jp: あんな店で待つくらいなら、歩いて帰る。
examples.en: Sooner than wait at that shop, I'll walk home.
examples.fr: Sooner than wait at that shop, I'll walk home.

examples.jp: 捨てるくらいなら、私にください。
examples.en: Rather than throw it away, give it to me.
examples.fr: Rather than throw it away, give it to me.

meaning.en: carried too far by a feeling
meaning.fr: carried too far by a feeling

examples.jp: うれしさのあまり、涙が出た。
examples.en: I was so overjoyed that tears came.
examples.fr: I was so overjoyed that tears came.

examples.jp: 心配のあまり、夜も眠れなかった。
examples.en: So great was my worry that I could not sleep at night.
examples.fr: So great was my worry that I could not sleep at night.

meaning.en: judging even from that one part
meaning.fr: judging even from that one part

examples.jp: その言い方からして、彼は怒っている。
examples.en: Judging even from the way he said it, he is angry.
examples.fr: Judging even from the way he said it, he is angry.

examples.jp: 見た目からして、この料理はおいしそうだ。
examples.en: Going by its appearance alone, this dish looks delicious.
examples.fr: Going by its appearance alone, this dish looks delicious.

meaning.fr: seen from that position

examples.jp: これまでの経験からすると、うまくいくだろう。
examples.en: Going by experience so far, it should go well.
examples.fr: Going by experience so far, it should go well.

examples.jp: この足あとからすると、犯人は大きな男だ。
examples.en: From these footprints, the culprit is a large man.
examples.fr: From these footprints, the culprit is a large man.

structure: noun + にしろ + noun + にしろ

meaning.en: whichever of the two it turns out to be
meaning.fr: whichever of the two it turns out to be

examples.jp: 行くにしろ行かないにしろ、早く決めてください。
examples.en: Whether you go or not, please decide soon.
examples.fr: Whether you go or not, please decide soon.

examples.jp: 雨にしろ雪にしろ、明日は出発します。
examples.en: Rain or snow, we set off tomorrow.
examples.fr: Rain or snow, we set off tomorrow.

structure: verb た-form/noun + の + 末に

meaning.en: after ..., in the end (following a process)
meaning.fr: after ..., in the end (following a process)

examples.jp: 長い間考えた末に、留学を決めました。
examples.en: After thinking about it for a long time, I decided to study abroad.
examples.fr: After thinking about it for a long time, I decided to study abroad.

examples.jp: 何度も話し合った末に、計画は中止になった。
examples.en: After discussing it many times, the plan was called off in the end.
examples.fr: After discussing it many times, the plan was called off in the end.

meaning.en: as soon as; also: it depends on
meaning.fr: as soon as; also: it depends on

examples.jp: 向こうに着き次第、電話します。
examples.en: I will call you as soon as I arrive over there.
examples.fr: I will call you as soon as I arrive over there.

examples.jp: 試合をするかどうかは天気次第だ。
examples.en: Whether we play the match depends on the weather.
examples.fr: Whether we play the match depends on the weather.

meaning.en: there is no chance of it
meaning.fr: there is no chance of it

examples.jp: そんな話、だれも信じっこない。
examples.en: Nobody is going to believe a story like that.
examples.fr: Nobody is going to believe a story like that.

examples.jp: 一日で全部覚えられっこない。
examples.en: There's no way of memorising it all in a day.
examples.fr: There's no way of memorising it all in a day.

meaning.en: in the process of, gradually doing
meaning.fr: in the process of, gradually doing

examples.jp: この町の人口は少しずつ変わりつつある。
examples.en: The population of this town is gradually changing.
examples.fr: The population of this town is gradually changing.

examples.jp: 彼の病気は少しずつ良くなりつつある。
examples.en: His illness is gradually getting better.
examples.fr: His illness is gradually getting better.

structure: noun / verb dictionary form + どころではない

meaning.en: the situation does not allow it
meaning.fr: the situation does not allow it

examples.jp: 仕事が忙しくて、旅行どころではない。
examples.en: Work is so busy that a trip is out of the question.
examples.fr: Work is so busy that a trip is out of the question.

examples.jp: 熱があって、勉強どころではなかった。
examples.en: I had a fever and was in no state to study.
examples.fr: I had a fever and was in no state to study.

structure: noun + も + verb ば-form + noun + も

meaning.fr: both this and that alike

examples.jp: 彼は歌も歌えば、絵もかく。
examples.en: He both sings and paints.
examples.fr: He both sings and paints.

examples.jp: この町は海もあれば、山もある。
examples.en: This town has both the sea and the mountains.
examples.fr: This town has both the sea and the mountains.

structure: noun + やら + noun + やら

meaning.en: what with one thing and another
meaning.fr: what with one thing and another

examples.jp: 休みの日は、そうじやら買い物やらで忙しい。
examples.en: On my days off, what with cleaning and shopping, I'm busy.
examples.fr: On my days off, what with cleaning and shopping, I'm busy.

examples.jp: うれしいやら悲しいやら、変な気持ちだ。
examples.en: What with joy and sadness, I feel strange.
examples.fr: What with joy and sadness, I feel strange.

meaning.fr: depuis (que)

examples.jp: 日本に来て以来、一度も国へ帰っていない。
examples.en: Ever since I came to Japan, I haven't been home once.
examples.fr: Depuis que je suis arrivé au Japon, je ne suis pas rentré une seule fois au pays.

examples.jp: 卒業以来、彼とは会っていない。
examples.en: I haven't seen him since graduation.
examples.fr: Je ne l'ai pas revu depuis la fin de nos études.

structure: verb た-form + かと思うと／かと思ったら

meaning.fr: à peine... que

examples.jp: 空が暗くなったかと思うと、大雨が降り出した。
examples.en: No sooner had the sky darkened than it began to pour.
examples.fr: À peine le ciel s'était-il assombri qu'il s'est mis à pleuvoir à verse.

examples.jp: 子どもはないたかと思うと、もう笑っている。
examples.en: The child was crying one moment and is already laughing the next.
examples.fr: L'enfant pleurait à l'instant, et le voilà déjà qui rit.

structure: verb dictionary form + か + verb ない-form + かのうちに

meaning.fr: à peine... que déjà

examples.jp: ベルが鳴るか鳴らないかのうちに、生徒たちは教室を出た。
examples.en: The instant the bell rang, the students were out of the classroom.
examples.fr: La sonnerie avait à peine retenti que les élèves étaient déjà sortis.

examples.jp: 家に着くか着かないかのうちに、電話が鳴った。
examples.en: I had barely got home when the phone rang.
examples.fr: J'étais à peine rentré que le téléphone a sonné.

meaning.en: now that, since (a decision is made)
meaning.fr: puisque, dès lors que

examples.jp: 約束した上は、最後までやります。
examples.en: Now that I've promised, I'll see it through to the end.
examples.fr: Puisque j'ai promis, j'irai jusqu'au bout.

examples.jp: 引き受けた上は、責任を持って働きたい。
examples.en: Since I've taken it on, I want to work responsibly.
examples.fr: Dès lors que j'ai accepté, je veux travailler avec sérieux.

structure: verb / adjective plain form + としても

meaning.fr: même si, à supposer que

examples.jp: 雨が降ったとしても、試合は行われる。
examples.en: Even if it rains, the match will go ahead.
examples.fr: Même s'il pleut, le match aura lieu.

examples.jp: 時間があったとしても、私は行かない。
examples.en: Even supposing I had time, I wouldn't go.
examples.fr: Même si j'avais le temps, je n'irais pas.

structure: noun / plain form + といっても

meaning.fr: même si je dis..., cela dit

examples.jp: 日本語ができるといっても、簡単な会話だけだ。
examples.en: I can speak Japanese, but only simple conversations.
examples.fr: Je parle japonais, mais seulement pour des conversations simples.

examples.jp: 旅行といっても、近くの町に行くだけです。
examples.en: It's a trip, but only to a nearby town.
examples.fr: Un voyage, c'est vite dit, on va juste dans une ville voisine.

structure: verb stem / noun / adjective + ながらも

meaning.fr: bien que, tout en

examples.jp: 彼は若いながらも、しっかりした考えを持っている。
examples.en: Though young, he has firm ideas of his own.
examples.fr: Bien que jeune, il a des idées bien arrêtées.

examples.jp: 悪いと知りながらも、うそをついてしまった。
examples.en: Even knowing it was wrong, I ended up lying.
examples.fr: Tout en sachant que c'était mal, j'ai fini par mentir.

structure: noun + はともかく（として）

meaning.fr: sans parler de, quoi qu'il en soit de

examples.jp: 味はともかく、この店は安い。
examples.en: Never mind the taste, this place is cheap.
examples.fr: Le goût, passons, mais ce restaurant est bon marché.

examples.jp: 勝ち負けはともかく、よく戦った。
examples.en: Win or lose, you fought well.
examples.fr: Victoire ou défaite, tu t'es bien battu.

structure: noun + から見ると／から見れば

meaning.en: judging from, from the point of view of
meaning.fr: à en juger par, du point de vue de

examples.jp: 外国人から見ると、日本の駅はとても複雑だ。
examples.en: From a foreigner's point of view, Japanese stations are very complex.
examples.fr: Du point de vue d'un étranger, les gares japonaises sont très compliquées.

examples.jp: この字から見ると、彼は急いで書いたようだ。
examples.en: Judging from this handwriting, he seems to have written it in a hurry.
examples.fr: À en juger par l'écriture, il semble avoir écrit à la hâte.

structure: noun (a person) + にしたら／にすれば

meaning.fr: pour (quelqu'un), de son point de vue

examples.jp: 親にしたら、子どもの帰りが遅いのは心配だ。
examples.en: For a parent, a child coming home late is worrying.
examples.fr: Pour des parents, un enfant qui rentre tard, c'est inquiétant.

examples.jp: 学生にしたら、テストは少ないほうがいい。
examples.en: From a student's standpoint, the fewer tests the better.
examples.fr: Du point de vue d'un étudiant, moins il y a d'examens, mieux c'est.

meaning.fr: sur (une durée, une étendue), pendant tout

examples.jp: 工事は三か月にわたって行われた。
examples.en: The works were carried out over three months.
examples.fr: Les travaux se sont déroulés sur trois mois.

examples.jp: 雨は全国にわたって降るでしょう。
examples.en: Rain will fall across the whole country.
examples.fr: Il pleuvra sur tout le pays.

meaning.fr: centré sur, autour de

examples.jp: この店は若い女性を中心に人気がある。
examples.en: This shop is popular mainly with young women.
examples.fr: Ce magasin est surtout populaire auprès des jeunes femmes.

examples.jp: 駅を中心に、町が広がっている。
examples.en: The town spreads out around the station.
examples.fr: La ville s'étend autour de la gare.

meaning.fr: en raison de (avis) ; par (unité)

examples.jp: 工事中につき、ご注意ください。
examples.en: Due to construction, please take care.
examples.fr: Travaux en cours, prière de faire attention.

examples.jp: 一人につき二枚まで買えます。
examples.en: You can buy up to two per person.
examples.fr: Deux billets maximum par personne.

meaning.fr: chaque fois que (une émotion revient)

examples.jp: この写真を見るにつけ、昔を思い出す。
examples.en: Every time I see this photo, I remember the old days.
examples.fr: Chaque fois que je vois cette photo, je repense au passé.

examples.jp: 彼の話を聞くにつけ、うらやましく思う。
examples.en: Whenever I hear his stories, I feel envious.
examples.fr: Chaque fois que j'entends ses récits, je l'envie.

meaning.fr: destiné à, conçu pour

examples.jp: これは子ども向けの本です。
examples.en: This is a book for children.
examples.fr: C'est un livre destiné aux enfants.

examples.jp: 外国人向けに、英語の地図を作った。
examples.en: We made an English map for foreigners.
examples.fr: Nous avons préparé une carte en anglais à l'intention des étrangers.

meaning.fr: l'air..., avec un air

examples.jp: 彼は悲しげな顔で立っていた。
examples.en: He stood there with a sad look on his face.
examples.fr: Il se tenait là, l'air triste.

examples.jp: 子どもたちは楽しげに遊んでいる。
examples.en: The children are playing happily.
examples.fr: Les enfants jouent d'un air joyeux.

meaning.fr: qui vaut la peine, gratifiant

examples.jp: この仕事はやりがいがある。
examples.en: This job is rewarding.
examples.fr: Ce travail est gratifiant.

examples.jp: 生きがいを見つけることは大切だ。
examples.en: It is important to find something to live for.
examples.fr: Il est important de trouver une raison de vivre.

structure: noun (a person) + のことだから

meaning.fr: connaissant (quelqu'un)

examples.jp: まじめな彼のことだから、遅れることはないだろう。
examples.en: Knowing how earnest he is, he won't be late.
examples.fr: Le connaissant si sérieux, il ne sera pas en retard.

examples.jp: あの子のことだから、また忘れたのだろう。
examples.en: Being who she is, she probably forgot again.
examples.fr: Connaissant cette enfant, elle a sans doute encore oublié.

structure: verb て-form / adjective て-form + ならない

meaning.fr: ne pas pouvoir s'empêcher de, terriblement

examples.jp: 試験のことが気になってならない。
examples.en: I can't stop worrying about the exam.
examples.fr: Je ne peux pas m'empêcher de penser à l'examen.

examples.jp: 一人で暮らすと、さびしくてならない。
examples.en: Living alone, I feel unbearably lonely.
examples.fr: En vivant seul, je me sens terriblement seul.

structure: question word + plain form + ことか

meaning.fr: comme... ! (exclamatif)

examples.jp: 合格して、どんなにうれしかったことか。
examples.en: How happy I was to pass!
examples.fr: Comme j'étais heureux d'avoir réussi !

examples.jp: この日を何年待ったことか。
examples.en: How many years I have waited for this day!
examples.fr: Combien d'années ai-je attendu ce jour !

structure: verb dictionary form / ない-form + ことだ

meaning.fr: il faut (conseil)

examples.jp: うまくなりたければ、毎日練習することだ。
examples.en: If you want to get good, you should practise every day.
examples.fr: Si tu veux progresser, il faut t'entraîner tous les jours.

examples.jp: 体が弱いなら、休みをよく取ることだ。
examples.en: If you're not strong, you should rest often.
examples.fr: Si tu es fragile, il faut te reposer souvent.

structure: emotion adjective / verb た-form + ことに

meaning.fr: à ma (grande surprise, joie)...

examples.jp: おどろいたことに、彼は一週間で日本語を覚えた。
examples.en: To my surprise, he learnt Japanese in a week.
examples.fr: À ma grande surprise, il a appris le japonais en une semaine.

examples.jp: 残念なことに、その店は閉まっていた。
examples.en: Unfortunately, the shop was closed.
examples.fr: Malheureusement, le magasin était fermé.

meaning.fr: du fait que, d'où

examples.jp: この町は花が多いことから、花の町と呼ばれている。
examples.en: Because it has so many flowers, this town is called the town of flowers.
examples.fr: Comme elle compte beaucoup de fleurs, cette ville est appelée la ville des fleurs.

examples.jp: 窓が開いていたことから、泥棒が入ったと分かった。
examples.en: From the open window, we knew a thief had got in.
examples.fr: La fenêtre ouverte nous a fait comprendre qu'un voleur était entré.

structure: noun / plain form + というものだ

meaning.en: that is what... is, that's just...
meaning.fr: c'est là ce qu'on appelle..., c'est tout simplement

examples.jp: 困っている人を助けるのが友情というものだ。
examples.en: Helping a friend in need, that's what friendship is.
examples.fr: Aider un ami dans le besoin, c'est cela l'amitié.

examples.jp: 一日で覚えろというのは、ひどいというものだ。
examples.en: Telling someone to learn it in a day is simply cruel.
examples.fr: Demander de tout apprendre en un jour, c'est tout bonnement cruel.

structure: plain form + というものではない／というものでもない

meaning.en: it doesn't follow that, not necessarily
meaning.fr: ce n'est pas pour autant que, pas forcément

examples.jp: 高ければいいというものではない。
examples.en: Expensive doesn't necessarily mean good.
examples.fr: Ce n'est pas parce que c'est cher que c'est bien.

examples.jp: 速く書けばいいというものではない。
examples.en: Writing fast isn't the point.
examples.fr: Écrire vite n'est pas ce qui compte.

structure: verb ない-stem + ずに済む／ないで済む

meaning.en: get by without, manage without having to
meaning.fr: s'en tirer sans, éviter d'avoir à

examples.jp: 友だちが車で送ってくれたので、歩かずに済んだ。
examples.en: A friend drove me, so I didn't have to walk.
examples.fr: Un ami m'a emmené en voiture, je n'ai donc pas eu à marcher.

examples.jp: けがは軽く、入院せずに済んだ。
examples.en: The injury was minor and I avoided a hospital stay.
examples.fr: La blessure était légère et j'ai évité l'hospitalisation.

meaning.en: only by doing, it is precisely because
meaning.fr: ce n'est qu'en..., c'est justement en

examples.jp: 自分でやってこそ、意味がある。
examples.en: It only has meaning if you do it yourself.
examples.fr: Cela n'a de sens que si tu le fais toi-même.

examples.jp: 苦労してこそ、勝つ喜びが分かる。
examples.en: Only through hardship do you understand the joy of winning.
examples.fr: Ce n'est qu'après avoir peiné qu'on comprend la joie de gagner.

meaning.en: at least..., it could be worse
meaning.fr: c'est déjà ça, au moins

examples.jp: 給料は安いが、仕事があるだけましだ。
examples.en: The pay is low, but at least I have a job.
examples.fr: Le salaire est bas, mais avoir un travail, c'est déjà ça.

examples.jp: けがをしたが、命があるだけましだ。
examples.en: I was injured, but at least I'm alive.
examples.fr: Je suis blessé, mais je suis vivant, c'est le principal.

meaning.en: only when, of all (things, times, people)
meaning.fr: précisément (quand, celui-là), justement

examples.jp: 急いでいる時に限って、電車が遅れる。
examples.en: It's precisely when I'm in a hurry that the train is late.
examples.fr: C'est justement quand je suis pressé que le train a du retard.

examples.jp: うちの子に限って、そんなことはしない。
examples.en: My child, of all people, would never do that.
examples.fr: Mon enfant, lui, ne ferait jamais une chose pareille.

meaning.fr: en réponse à (une demande, une attente)

examples.jp: お客様の声にこたえて、営業時間を延ばした。
examples.en: In response to customer feedback, we extended our opening hours.
examples.fr: En réponse aux demandes des clients, nous avons prolongé les horaires.

examples.jp: 両親の期待にこたえて、彼は医者になった。
examples.en: Living up to his parents' hopes, he became a doctor.
examples.fr: Répondant aux attentes de ses parents, il est devenu médecin.

meaning.fr: avec (un sentiment), de tout son

examples.jp: 心をこめて、この手紙を書きました。
examples.en: I wrote this letter with all my heart.
examples.fr: J'ai écrit cette lettre de tout mon cœur.

examples.jp: お礼の気持ちをこめて、花を送った。
examples.en: I sent flowers with my thanks.
examples.fr: J'ai envoyé des fleurs en signe de gratitude.

structure: verb dictionary form / noun + と同時に

meaning.en: at the same time as; as well as
meaning.fr: en même temps que ; à la fois

examples.jp: ドアが開くと同時に、人が入ってきた。
examples.en: The instant the door opened, people came in.
examples.fr: Au moment même où la porte s'est ouverte, des gens sont entrés.

examples.jp: この仕事は大変であると同時に、楽しい。
examples.en: This job is hard and at the same time enjoyable.
examples.fr: Ce travail est à la fois difficile et plaisant.

structure: verb ている-form / た-form + ところに／ところへ

meaning.en: just when, right at the moment
meaning.fr: juste au moment où

examples.jp: 出かけようとしたところに、電話がかかってきた。
examples.en: Just as I was about to leave, the phone rang.
examples.fr: Juste au moment où j'allais sortir, on m'a appelé.

examples.jp: 困っているところに、友だちが来てくれた。
examples.en: Right when I was in trouble, a friend came by.
examples.fr: Alors que j'étais dans l'embarras, un ami est venu.

meaning.en: for the first time in (a span)
meaning.fr: pour la première fois depuis

examples.jp: 十年ぶりに、高校の友だちに会った。
examples.en: I met a high-school friend for the first time in ten years.
examples.fr: J'ai revu un ami du lycée pour la première fois en dix ans.

examples.jp: 三日ぶりに、ゆっくり眠れた。
examples.en: I slept properly for the first time in three days.
examples.fr: J'ai enfin bien dormi, après trois jours.

meaning.fr: seulement, uniquement (formel)

examples.jp: 会員のみ、この部屋を利用できます。
examples.en: Only members may use this room.
examples.fr: Seuls les membres peuvent utiliser cette salle.

examples.jp: あとは返事を待つのみだ。
examples.en: All that's left is to wait for the reply.
examples.fr: Il ne reste plus qu'à attendre la réponse.

structure: noun + までして / verb て-form + まで

meaning.fr: aller jusqu'à

examples.jp: 借金までして、車を買う必要はない。
examples.en: There's no need to go as far as borrowing money to buy a car.
examples.fr: Pas besoin d'aller jusqu'à s'endetter pour acheter une voiture.

examples.jp: 彼は仕事を休んでまでして、試合を見に行った。
examples.en: He went so far as to skip work to watch the match.
examples.fr: Il est allé jusqu'à manquer le travail pour voir le match.

structure: verb dictionary form + ところだった

meaning.fr: avoir failli

examples.jp: もう少しで、電車に乗り遅れるところだった。
examples.en: I very nearly missed the train.
examples.fr: J'ai bien failli rater le train.

examples.jp: あぶない。転ぶところだった。
examples.en: Careful! I almost fell.
examples.fr: Ouf ! J'ai failli tomber.
